analytics.name: Analytic 1847
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Native API from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: App loads native library (.so) or resolves JNI bridge NOT IN $ApprovedNativeLibraries$ immediately before suspicious lower-level activity (sensor access, file write, network connection) — native code loading before anomalous activity is the]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Expected native libraries for each app (game engines: Unity/libil2cpp, Unreal; media: libffmpeg; React Native: libreactnative). Derive from app package manifest and vendor documentation. Tightening: strict per-app allowlist.
Default 30s between native library load and anomalous activity. Native code executes synchronously after load.
